nodes.label: ADR 0208: The song's menu is only buttons round the pointer, wherever it was clicked
nodes.rationale: The user said the big round box with the song name and level mixed information and a menu in one, and wanted the menu around the cursor. Clicking a song in the running order showed the menu above, not at the cursor, so the menu is placed in the window at the pointer. Rejected alternative: the level as a value in a corner of the ring, which put information back into the menu. Supersedes ADR 0207's centre only; the rest of 0207 stands.

hyperedges.label: The set's song menu: one round menu, trimmed, buttons only at the pointer
